name: Milt Jackson
description: '''Milton Jackson''' (January 1, 1923 – October 9, 1999), nicknamed "'''Bags'''", was an American [[jazz]] [[Vibraphone|vibraphonist]]. He is especially remembered for his cool swinging solos as a member of the [[Modern Jazz Quartet]] and his penchant for collaborating with [[hard bop]] and [[post-bop]] players. A very expressive player, Jackson was particularly fond of the [[twelve-bar blues]] at slow tempos. On occasion, he also sang and played piano.
